strings.name: Roland Busch
strings.summary: Trained as a physicist, Busch moved into industrial management across automotive technology, transport and corporate strategy. Siemens president and CEO since 2021, he has promoted digital twins, industrial software and AI, including the Xcelerator platform. His renewed five-year term began in 2025; he continued leading the group and discussing industrial digitalization in 2026.
